events.title: Craft CMS 1.0 released
events.summary: Pixel & Tonic released Craft CMS 1.0 on June 4, 2013 — a flexible PHP content management system with live preview and custom fields.
events.about: Craft gave developers Matrix fields, live preview, and Twig templating without WordPress plugin sprawl — born from the ExpressionEngine add-on ecosystem. It became the preferred CMS for agencies building bespoke content sites before headless took over.

narrative.whyChosen: Craft CMS proved a modern PHP CMS could compete with WordPress on developer experience.
narrative.whyImportant: Matrix fields and live preview set new standards for flexible content modeling.
narrative.problemSolved: Developers wanted CMS power without WordPress bloat or ExpressionEngine rigidity.
